EP-1704是E20环氧树脂的水分散体，特别适用于水性金属防锈底漆。
自乳化固体环氧，储存稳定性佳，储存过程粘度稳定；
对配方设计的容忍度高，可直接用于色浆研磨；
EP-1704对多数金属底材都具备优异的附着力，适合制备防锈底漆与防护涂料；为获得更出色的防腐效果，一般建议固化剂添加量为化学理论计算量的85±5%。
EP-1704水性环氧分散体须密封保存。建议储存在5-35摄氏度条件下储存，严禁冰冻。勿与油漆类相混。本产品自发货之日起保质期为6个月，但不代表超过6个月无法使用，建议使用前进行产品性能评估，以确保使用安全。

PU-1001 is an aliphatic anionic waterborne polyurethane dispersion with strong adhesion, used to improve interlayer adhesion.

PU-1001 forms a very soft film with strong adhesion, suitable for use alone as a tie coat or blended with other materials to improve interlayer adhesion and physical properties without increasing coating stiffness.
As an aliphatic polyurethane resin with excellent yellowing resistance, PU-1001 is widely used for white and light-colored leathers.
Store in a ventilated, dry area at 5-35°C; protect from freezing. Shelf life is 6 months from shipment. Products older than 6 months should be re-evaluated before use.
